subject: AWS links with Azure ☁️, Gemini takes on busywork 🤖, Java4Shell threatens enterprise apps 🚨
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or model pricing in this issue. Sponsor items (Redwood, Dataiku) ignored.

stories.headline: AWS Interconnect reaches general availability, linking AWS and Microsoft Azure privately
stories.quote: AWS Interconnect now links AWS and Microsoft Azure privately, replacing the do-it-yourself networking customers previously had to build.

stories.headline: Microsoft and other organisations launch an AI transparency initiative for enterprise AI models and agents
stories.quote: The initiative aims to establish open, industrywide standards for AI security, governance, and transparency across models and providers to help enterprises independently verify AI agent behavior.

stories.headline: Google's Gemini Tasks performs agentic actions, powered by the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model
stories.quote: Gemini Tasks can perform agentic actions such as calling businesses, booking appointments, managing calendars, and completing purchases via Google Pay.

facts.text: The new features run on Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.
facts.quote: The new features are powered by Google's latest Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.

stories.headline: Microsoft announces general availability of its Windows endpoint security platform
stories.quote: Microsoft has announced general availability of its Windows endpoint security platform, which gives third-party security vendors a way to protect systems without relying as heavily on kernel-level software.

stories.headline: Oracle patches Java4Shell, a Java flaw allowing unauthenticated code execution
stories.quote: Oracle patched a Java vulnerability that can let unauthenticated attackers execute code or crash affected systems.

facts.text: Researchers demonstrated attacks against Jira, Confluence, Jenkins and Elasticsearch.
facts.quote: Researchers demonstrated attacks against applications including Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Elasticsearch, with exposure depending on the underlying Java version and CPU configuration.

stories.headline: Microsoft expands Intel agreement: multi-year Xeon supply and Intel EMIB packaging for Azure's own chips
stories.quote: Microsoft's expanded Intel agreement includes multi-year Xeon supply and plans to use Intel's EMIB packaging technology for Azure's own chips.
